newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen flat or slightly down on Tues.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen flat or slightly down on Tues.

text.p: Polish shares were seen maintaining their general flat trend before large forthcoming public offerings, with the market possibly dipping on Tuesday after recent gains and Monday's stronger post-fixing selling.
Bank Handlowy's public offering estimated at around $1 billion starts in late May but analysts said the generally good macroeconomic mood prevented major selling.
Analysts said some stocks on Tuesday could react to Monday's April earnings data, with some banks possibly having ended their recent rally amid continued weak earnings. @
Chemical company Viscoplast starts trade on the parallel market on Tuesday.
